issue.title: Identify the tool that leaked 313 future-dated ace-run month shards
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `~/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/artifacts/ace-run/` (313 six-digit month dirs such as `213601`, `213510`)

On 2026-07-24 between 22:10:32 and 23:02:49 local, something created 313 future-dated ace-run month shards under the real sase project artifact store. Each shard has only empty day directories and no files. Names run from `202704` through `213601`. A grep of `tests/` and `src/` during `plan:202608/ace_stale_node_status.md` did not identify the creator.

## Repro

```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
root = Path.home() / ".sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/artifacts/ace-run"
cur = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m")
future = [
    p for p in root.iterdir()
    if p.is_dir() and p.name.isdigit() and len(p.name) == 6 and p.name > cur
]
print(len(future), "future month shards; newest", sorted(p.name for p in future)[-5:])
print("files", sum(1 for p in future for f in p.rglob("*") if f.is_file()))
PY
```

Inventory snapshot: `file:explicit:46062759532d6978597e0985`.

## Impact

Lexicographic ACE startup watches used to pick `213601`/`213510` for both month slots, leaving the live `202608` tree unwatched so Agents-tab statuses lagged up to 60s. Date-aware watch selection now ignores future shards; the leak into the real `~/.sase` remains. Do not delete the shards until the creator is identified. Likely a test or tool that wrote through the unsandboxed home on 2026-07-24.
